meta.title: Clap-Lite
meta.notes: One paid generation, extended once, with our graphics laid over it. clap-2a-t2 (8 s, from ad-clap-2a; t1 was rejected) was continued by the provider with ad-clap-2b (8 s), which returns the source clip and its new tail as one 16 s file, clap-2-full-t1; its first 191 frames match clap-2a-t2 and the demos start on frame 191 (7.958 s). compose.mjs then laid our CLAP-LITE (12.0 s, faded in over 0.2 s), ONLY $19.95 (13.0 s) and blinking CALL NOW 555-0147 (13.6 s, on for the first 0.42 s of every 0.7 s) over the packshot, each to 16.1 s (past the end, so the cut ends them), and copied the sound, giving clap-2-final, byte-identical to review/clips/ad-clap-lite-take2.mp4. The segments are the take's own shots, in step, cut where the picture cuts (frame/24). All the sound is the take's own: the announcer, the sung jingle, the claps. The storyboard's "Ow!" from Grandma isn't transcribed, so it isn't a line. The jingle is sung in the take's own sound, so it is a music item that labels it, with its words as a sung line heard in it.
